exposure: Patients were grouped by previous cesarean section status (C/S group vs. non-C/S group)
Previous cesarean section (C/S) status (yes vs. no)
finding: Previous cesarean section, abortion history, and pretreatment β-hCG were independent risk factors for post-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a strong risk factor for the occurrence of post-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and invasive mole.
